reports.title: Early S25 renders suggested only a modest redesign
reports.summary: Leaked design renders of the base Galaxy S25 suggested a smaller handset with familiar styling rather than a major visual overhaul.

reports.title: Display glass for all three S25 models leaked
reports.summary: A leak presented what appeared to be display glass for the Galaxy S25, S25+ and S25 Ultra, offering an early size and shape comparison.

reports.title: S25+ CAD renders showed flat sides and a triple camera
reports.summary: CAD-based renders suggested the S25+ would retain a flat-sided design and triple rear camera arrangement, with battery details also reported alongside them.

reports.title: Leaked S25+ hands-on images exposed camera rings and antenna details
reports.summary: Live images of the S25+ were reported to show solid camera rings and a mmWave antenna, adding physical detail beyond CAD renders.

reports.title: Full S25 family renders leaked in multiple colorways
reports.summary: Official-looking renders for the S25, S25+ and S25 Ultra appeared just before launch, showing colors, camera treatments and the Ultra's rounded corners.
